name: Cooler Control
author: Eduard G. Castelló
description: Real-time CPU temperature graph and fan speed gauge, with slider-driven fan curves for every pwm-capable CPU/case fan the system exposes. Expand for one card per fan: live duty/RPM, speed graph, and the curve with its thresholds.

barWidget.description: Temperature graph, fan speed gauge, fan curve control, and an expanded per-fan card view
